**18. FINANCIAL PROVISIONS**

18.1 The Grant Amount shall be disbursed in accordance with the Disbursement Schedule set out in Schedule A. All disbursements are subject to the conditions set out in this Agreement, including the submission of satisfactory reports and the availability of sufficient funds.

**19. PROCUREMENT**

19.1 MSC shall procure all goods, works, and services for the Activity in a transparent, competitive, and cost-effective manner, and in accordance with its own procurement policy, provided that such policy is consistent with the principles set out in this Clause.

19.2 Where the value of a single procurement exceeds S$10,000, MSC shall obtain at least three quotations, unless TT has agreed otherwise in writing. Where the value exceeds S$50,000, MSC shall conduct an open tender process, unless TT has agreed otherwise in writing.

(c) TT reasonably considers that the Grant Amount is being or is likely to be misused.

21.2 TT may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect by written notice to MSC if:
(a) MSC is in breach of any material term of this Agreement and fails to remedy such breach within 30 days of receiving written notice from TT;
(b) MSC becomes insolvent, goes into liquidation, or is otherwise unable to pay its debts as they fall due;
(c) an event of misconduct, fraud, or corruption is reasonably suspected or confirmed in relation to the Activity; or
(d) TT determines that the continued funding of the Activity would expose TT to material reputational risk.
